description: Use this when the person asks whether a resume or CV is good, ATS-friendly or ready to send, or asks for its score or what to fix. Takes the attached resume file (file), pasted resume text (sourceText) or a saved resume (resumeId); a job ad is optional. Works signed out. Returns CVEmber's ATS score, 0-100, and the first things to fix. Reads only and saves nothing. Do not use to save or edit a resume.

content.description: A pasted resume (contact, summary, experience, education, skills), when there is no resumeId.

file.description: The resume file the person attached (PDF, Word, text or a photo), passed as is.

download_url.description: Download link of the attached file.

keywords.description: Keywords from the job ad to check for; read from the ad when omitted.

sourceText.description: Text the person pasted, copied exactly.

name: score_resume
title: Check resume
